name: Movity
long_description: Movity provides location-based living facilities and neighborhood data that help home buyers make better decisions. Movity.com surfaces geodata (crime, noise, pricing, etc) to help home buyers make better decisions. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in San Francisco, California.
one_liner: Real estate data visualization.  Sold to Trulia Dec…
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Former cofounder of Movity (W10, sold to Trulia), now co-founder and COO of Nava. Nava is a public benefit corporation that was formed during the HealthCare.gov tech surge, and works across federal, state, and local levels to build better government services.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
I'm building Kivo Health: we provide telehealth lung rehab for COPD patients. We just raised our $10m Series A.

I'm a serial founder and technologist. I founded Movity in W2010 which exited to Trulia, and have built key tech at both startups and larger companies.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Founder at fpo3. Previously founded and led Opendoor as CEO (2014-2022) and President (2022-present), scaling it to a multi-billion dollar public company revolutionizing residential real estate. Previously founded Movity (YC W10), acquired by Trulia, where he then led Geo/Social Products. Third-time YC founder.
